task: Bounded original-manuscript / specific publisher audio recovery, no contact or publication
provenance_policy: Only source-specific file/episode identity, first-party authorization and recoverable bytes can upgrade statuses. An inaccessible URL, mirror index, or multi-domain syndication is not an authenticated original, a new intellectual work, or an independently verified recording.

targets.title: The Origins of Awareness
targets.existing_evidence: Explicitly attributed Yom Kippur 5761 sermon section in public 14-page mixed-author compilation; title and ending visible in secondary representations.
targets.this_pass: Targeted publisher, academic-domain, exact-title and legacy-path searches did not return an original Temple or authenticated university-hosted copy; authorized document-index search did not identify a clearly matching manuscript. Multiple public copies may share one upstream source.
targets.repeat_condition: Only revisit identical dead paths if a new archival resolver/capture, independently identified first-party archival holding, authorized title-matched original, or direct accessible file bytes becomes available.

targets.title: Post-September 11 delivered Erev Rosh Hashanah 5762 sermon
targets.existing_evidence: Rabbi Cohon's already indexed first-party September 2026 retrospective includes self-quoted excerpt and distinguishes delivered replacement from pre-9/11 undelivered drafts.
targets.this_pass: No original 2001 Temple manuscript identified in targeted public searches or titled authorized document-index search. Existing modern blog remains source of retrospective excerpt only.
targets.repeat_condition: Pursue only when an original dated 2001 Temple manuscript, service program or authorized held draft is independently identified; track delivered revision and unused drafts separately.

targets.title: The Necessary Chutzpah of Saving Refugees
targets.existing_evidence: URJ attributed 2015 sermon excerpt and editorial method stating a written text was obtained for every included sermon; Mark J. Pelavin compiled roundup.
targets.this_pass: Exact-title, publisher, archival-index and original-Tucson-domain searches did not recover complete text. Authorized document-index search provided no clearly matching manuscript. URJ page still excerpt-only.
targets.repeat_condition: New independent snapshot of exact old path, documented held submission, a specifically identified archived file or explicit permission to seek a copy; no unsolicited contact.

targets.title: Hearing Voices: Shoah: For Holocaust Remembrance Day
targets.existing_evidence: Publisher's Hearing Voices series index identifies Samuel Cohon as program presenter and links to a historical episode page.
targets.this_pass: Both first-party branded domain variants present the same episode listing, not independent audio witnesses. Publisher Listen destination continues inaccessible in web reader. Targeted exact-episode, mp3, repository and public-media searches yielded no grounded direct HV009 enclosure, published audio manifest or accessible original program file.
targets.repeat_condition: New source-supplied enclosure URL or documented public-radio distributor accession ID with an independently verifiable media file. Do not reconstruct URL by guessing filenames.

targets.title: Temple Emanu-El 2013 historical class podcast account
targets.existing_evidence: First-party congregation email in April 2013 advertises podcast channel; no indexed specific episode has been authenticated.
targets.this_pass: No separate class item GUID, specific episode permalink, original audio enclosure or master was discovered. Generic Podbean channel and prior inaccessible RSS URLs do not qualify as a recording.
targets.repeat_condition: Contemporaneous verified RSS snapshot with item GUID/enclosure; first-party episode permalink; or authorized named class master with verified metadata. Never promote advertised class dates alone.

read_only_private_search.scope: Authorized linked document index, exact source titles and 2001/2015 date variations
read_only_private_search.finding: No confidently identifiable original for the requested 2000, 2001 or 2015 manuscripts. Keyword matches were often unrelated documents; no irrelevant document bodies were opened.
